"Have you not learned!?
So you too would invade our land!"{w}
"This land belongs to us, the Ryug.{w}We will never hand it over to the likes of you."{w}
"This land is not where you will find healing.{w}Withdraw."{w}
Somehow, you managed to drive off the Ryug.{w}Then you told them that you had heard about this land from Hisbert.{w}
"It must mean the situation has grown that dire.{w}The power of the Dark Realm has certainly become something we cannot ignore."{w}
"But this land has only just been born.{w}Even our power has its limits."{w}
"Even so, we must drive them back.{w}This is our land, the land of the chosen!"{w}

"......{w}You were told by Hisbert to come to this land."{w}{p}"That means fighting the forces of the Dark Realm.{w}If the librarian of the Elminage System says so,
our own power must not be enough..."{w}{p}"Galling as that is."{w}

"No... Then we just stay like this...
unable to do anything..."{w}

"Nonsense! Then why are we here!?
Are you saying the gods have abandoned us!?"{w}

"I don't know... But they are here.{w}Their power, strong enough to drive back even us...
That must be what Hisbert saw in them."{w}
"Adventurers.{w}This land now stands under threat from the Dark Realm."{w}{p}"Would you be willing to save this land with your strength?"{w}

"Envoys of the honored Hisbert or not,
borrowing the strength of otherworlders...
Do you mean to sully the pride of the Ryug!?"{w}{p}"Besides, can they truly be trusted?
These creatures of a lower race?"{w}

"Then we should simply perish as we are?{w}I have no intention of indulging that drivel
about the beauty of a noble end."{w}

"Stop it, both of you.{w}Then here is what we shall do."{w}{p}"It is true that we face a crisis.{w}And it is just as true that there are things we cannot manage on our own."{w}{p}"But however strong they may be, they are a lower race.{w}We are the Ryug, the chosen people."{w}{p}"So, how about this plan?{w}We will have them defeat those detestable Demon Dukes for us."{w}{p}"And then have them bring back proof of it."{w}

"Toiling away, are we, lower race?
Is the burden too heavy for the likes of you?"{w}

"And yet it is also true
that we must borrow that lower race's strength."{w}

"That's enough. We will be right here.
We'll be waiting for good news."{w}
"Well done, lower race!{w}Just what one would expect of adventurers chosen by us!"{w}
"Power enough to drive back even the Demon Dukes...{w}Perhaps the word 'hero' was made for the likes of you."{w}
"Thanks to you, a time of healing will come to this land as well."{w}

"We have been saved.{w}But your own goal is not yet achieved, is it?"{w}{p}"Our power may fall short, but tell us if there is anything we can do.{w}On the pride of the Ryug, we will see your wish granted without fail."{w}
"Then I'll have you grant my wish."{w}
"And you are...? Could you be that...{w}wicked mage...?"{w}{p}"It was not you who defeated the Demon Dukes, surely."{w}
"Their goal... and you are connected to it...{w}Is that right...?"{w}
"The Sanctum of Genesis? What could be in a place like that...?"{w}
"With our power it is not impossible, but what are you scheming?"{w}

"We could not make Rafa a true Sun Spirit.{w}And because of that, Rafa and
Yorfa both had to suffer so..."{w}
"The Sun Spirit...{w}So you too were striving to save a land."{w}
"The Dark Realm's invasion must be stopped."{w}

"If that Sun Spirit is restored, it could become a means of countering the Dark Realm."{w}{p}"That is so, is it not?
Very well."{w}
"We shall send you to the Sanctum of Genesis."{w}
Go to the Sanctum of Genesis?
"When you are ready, come to us."{w}

You heard a loud, haughty laugh.{w}{p}A figure slowly took shape in the empty air...{w}and suddenly a stench stung your noses.{w}{p}Poison? All at once, you found it hard to breathe.{w}

The back of your throat turned raw and scratchy,
and breathing grew difficult.{w}What could have come over you so suddenly?{w}
Fighting the discomfort, you looked toward the source of the smell{w}and saw a man, contentedly bathing in hot water.{w}Hot water? That must be what was causing the stench.{w}
"Come on, come a little closer.{w}It's all right, I won't do anything. Okay?{w}By the way, are there any women among you?"{w}

With a strange whirring, a Tetramystica glides across the floor.{w}{p}A Tetramystica specialized for guard duty -- a "Guard Mystica," you might call it.{w}{p}Here and there the students have scrawled on it: "Idiot," "Moron," even doodled nose hairs.{w}Even so, its function of guarding the Academy is still fully intact.{w}{p}So it is only natural that, on spotting you outsiders who don't belong to the Academy, it moves to eliminate you.{w}

You have run into a foe you never expected.{w}A vast form, its whole body blazing with light.{w}{p}Without a sound, the very air shudders and trembles.{w}With the word "alien" lodged in your hearts, you stand exposed to its savage power.{w}
Suddenly, a gigantic beast appears before you.{w}Half tiger and half horse, it flails its arms and thrashes its whole body wildly.{w}{p}And now its fury turns on you as well.{w}
